}

data_1998 = {
    'Jan': 5.54, 'Feb': 5.57, 'Mar': 5.65, 'Apr': 5.64, 'May': 5.65, 'June': 5.50,
    'July': 5.46, 'Aug': 5.34, 'Sept': 4.81, 'Oct': 4.53, 'Nov': 4.83, 'Dec': 4.65
}

data_2003 = {
    'Jan': 4.05, 'Feb': 3.90, 'Mar': 3.81, 'Apr': 3.96, 'May': 3.57, 'June': 3.33,
    'July': 3.98, 'Aug': 4.45, 'Sept': 4.27, 'Oct': 4.29, 'Nov': 4.30, 'Dec': 4.27
}

# Order of months
months = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'June', 'July', 'Aug', 'Sept', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec']

# We need 3-month moving averages for March through December
# March's 3-month MA = (Jan + Feb + Mar) / 3
# April's 3-month MA = (Feb + Mar + Apr) / 3
# etc.

def calculate_3ma(data):

    for i in range(2, 12):  # March (index 2) to December (index 11)
